summary: Iteration 81 testing complete. Fixed critical bug in useResizableColumns hook and verified all 3 new features: (1) Sortable Part Number column with chevron in Items, Inventory, and Stores Stock tables - click cycles asc→desc with localeCompare numeric:true for natural ordering. (2) Resizable columns - all tables now have drag handles on every <th> right edge. (3) Stores Stock filter row no longer wraps - all 3 filters (Search, Category, Group) stay on same row at 1920px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: useResizableColumns hook was not attaching resizers because useEffect dependency [tableRef?.current] doesn't trigger re-runs when ref changes. Added deps parameter to allow pages to pass [items.length, loading] as dependencies.
FIXED: ItemsPage.js, InventoryPage.js, WarehousesPage.js - moved useResizableColumns call after state declarations to avoid 'Cannot access before initialization' error.
VERIFIED: Part Number sorting uses localeCompare with {numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base'} for natural ordering (RM-1 < RM-2 < RM-10).
VERIFIED: Chevron indicator shows ▲ for ascending, ▼ for descending, with 'sorted' class applied to header.
VERIFIED: All 3 tables (Items: 9 cols, Inventory: 10 cols, Stores Stock: 8 cols) have resizer handles on every column.
VERIFIED: Stores Stock filter row - Search Y=209, Group Y=209, difference=0px - all filters on same row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 fixed useResizableColumns hook bug. The hook now accepts a second parameter 'deps' (array) that triggers re-attachment when dependencies change. Pages must call useResizableColumns(tableRef, [items.length, loading]) AFTER the state declarations to avoid initialization errors. All 3 features verified: (1) Part Number sorting with chevron, (2) Column resizers on all tables, (3) Stores Stock filter row no-wrap.

tests: Chevron shows ▲ initially, ▼ after second click
Sort order changes correctly (ASC then DESC)
All filters on same row at 1920px viewport

bug_fixed.issue: useResizableColumns hook not attaching resizers to table columns
bug_fixed.root_cause: useEffect dependency [tableRef?.current] doesn't trigger re-runs when ref.current changes. The effect ran on mount when loading=true (table not rendered), and never re-ran when table appeared.
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'deps' parameter to useResizableColumns hook. Pages now pass [items.length, loading] as dependencies to trigger re-attachment when data loads.
